name: mirage
text: BK3 answer: books at about -105/-110 on both sides each include 4-5% vig. Strip it and the fair price is 50% = +100. Novig is an exchange with no built-in vig, so +100 there is the true even price and looks like plus money next to -110 books. That alone is not an edge. It becomes one only when Novig pays MORE than the devigged fair (say +108 against a fair of +100), and then it is either a real +EV bet, a thin or stale order, or a mismatched line. The app already prices the taker fee and the book's age before listing it. If you have a specific bet you saw, tell me which and I'll check its numbers.
